# neon_branch_roles (Data Source)

Lists PostgreSQL roles in a Neon branch.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "neon_branch_roles" "this" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  branch_id  = var.branch_id
}

variable "project_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "branch_id" {
  type = string
}

output "roles" {
  value = data.neon_branch_roles.this.roles
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch_id` (String) Branch ID.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Role-list scope in the form `<project_id>/<branch_id>`.
- `roles` (Attributes List) Branch roles in API response order. An empty branch role list returns an empty list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) PostgreSQL role name.
- `protected` (Boolean) Whether the role is system-protected. Defaults to true when the API omits this field.
